display.interpretation: PASS covers loaded guides, HTTP/JavaScript, global page width, visible images and selected action bounds. Element-box candidates include intentionally clipped maps and scrollable navigation; they are not a proof that all content is fully visible or all domain data is accepted. Alerts retain actual missing-data states.
